item.content:encoded: This is a GOI Format featuring a Group of Interest that I had in my mind a very long time ago. The GOI in question was a military unit that was both aligned with the GOC and the Foundation and its purpose was the protection of the Philippine Islands against various anomalous threats. Said GOI will not hesitate to turn hostile against the Foundation nor the GOC (or any other GOIs) if they have committed morally questionable experiments that might result in death and destruction in the Philippines unless said experiment was for the greater good.
